name: cache-keepwarm
description: Protect cached context — Keep main-chat and sub-agent background waits warm with visible pokes, capped per wait, under rewrite-saving budgets.

scripts.test: vitest run --dir tests && npm run test:hooks
scripts.test:hooks: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'NOT RUN: missing claude'; exit 3; }; claude plugin test plugins/cache-keepwarm
scripts.validate:plugin: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'NOT RUN: missing claude'; exit 3; }; claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict plugins/cache-keepwarm
